photos.shows: Conchi from the west rocks: dark fractured volcanic rim, turquoise basin, one sea stack, and white surf in the open east gap
Shore of dark rounded boulders, white breaking surf, and a sea stack on the horizon. No sign, railing, or umbrella in frame
Aerial of the basin: turquoise pool in dark rock, open to the sea, with a pale sand beach on the landward side
Boca Keto approach west of the pool: brown gravel terrace, low grey-green scrub, a sand cove, and a rocky headland
